argv: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "name='chrome.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine; $p | ForEach-Object { $cl=$_.CommandLine; if($cl -match '--remote-debugging-port' -or $cl -match '--remote-debugging-pipe'){ [pscustomobject]@{ProcessId=$_.ProcessId; RemoteDebug=($cl -replace '(?i)(--user-data-dir=)[^ ]+','$1<redacted>')} } } | Format-List

note: Read-only check whether current Chrome exposes local DevTools transport; do not inspect credentials
